message: an unquoted `*` or `?` in an option value is a glob: it expands if a file matches and the shell may refuse the line when none does
help: quote the word so the glob reaches the program: `--include='*.rs'`, `'https://x/issues?since=1'`
notes: an unquoted glob in `--include=*.rs` was the commonest single failure in measured agent shell calls (268 `no matches found`)
